chapters.name: And So, It Begins
chapters.description: The very first tier, tier zero. This chapter will introduce you to the basic mechanics of this modpack. Mods covered: Vanilla, Pam's Harvestcraft.

chapters.name: Tips and Tricks
chapters.description: All our collected wisdom, in one convenient place. Many Greggers died to bring you this knowledge.

chapters.name: Tier 0 - Stone Age
chapters.description: This tab continues the basics until you make your first steam machine, and are ready for the real GT stuff

chapters.name: Tier 0.5 - Steam
chapters.description: Steam to electricity (EU) is the progression of this tab. Most of the machines you make in this tier you'll use the whole game, if in an upgraded form.

chapters.name: Tier 1 - LV
chapters.description: The first "voltage" tier of this pack. Things should be a little easier with some of the machines you can now make, and almost every type of machine is now available, try not to be overwhelmed. You can get away with using LV machines for automating processing of things like polyethylene or electrolyzing water the whole game, so consider setting that up when you need it.

chapters.name: Tier 2 - MV
chapters.description:
Your second voltage tier. Don't mix different voltage levels, or you'll have a fancy new crater. Start thinking about how to expand your base.

BTW, for OCing purposes, this counts as tier 2, ULV doesn't count.

chapters.name: Tier 3 - HV
chapters.description: Finally some real power to work with. This tier is all about getting to the moon to gather more rare resources to build even more advanced machines.

chapters.name: Tier 4 - EV
chapters.description: Welcome to EV! You have successfully gone to the moon and processed Titanium. You are now getting extreme levels of energy. In this tier you will unlock Nuclear energy, and Applied Energistics 2.

chapters.name: Tier 5 - IV
chapters.description: This tier is all about the platline, and making the assembly line. They're both super hard, but necessary. This is probably where most people drop out. Good luck!

chapters.name: Tier 6 - LuV
chapters.description:
If you have made it this far, you should walk with your head held high - you are nearing the start of the midgame. Endgame is still a long road ahead of you, but you are now becoming an expert at GTNH and most of the mods it comes with. Congrats, and be proud of yourself.

Once you're done being proud, start making CALs for better circuits, and work towards making power with the Fusion Reactor, you'll need it.

chapters.name: Tier 7 - ZPM
chapters.description: Congratulations, you've completed the platline, assline, CAL, §oand§r fusion reactor and made it to the Zero Point Module tier. You're well into the late game now, but there's still a lot of stuff to do. Good luck!

chapters.name: Tier 8 - UV
chapters.description: Ultimate Voltage! This is the final tier in normal GregTech, but here in GregTech: New Horizons, we pierce the heavens to go beyond the limit! You have done something that only a few players are capable of doing. Welcome to the Endgame!

chapters.name: Tier 9 - UHV
chapters.description: Uhh... hi? You really aren't supposed to be here, you know? For a long time, this tier was the Endgame, though at this point it's arguably the late-midgame. Congrats on making it; it only gets more fun from here!

chapters.name: Tier 10 - UEV
chapters.description: Still here? You should know what to do by now, but here's a rough guide of what's next.

chapters.name: Tier 11 - UIV
chapters.description:
Enjoying the pack so far?

Anyways here's your rough guide on the UIV progression.

chapters.name: Tier 12 - UMV
chapters.description: Maybe take a break every now and then...

chapters.name: Endgame Goals
chapters.description: Collection of endgame objectives, good luck and thanks for playing so far.

chapters.name: Feeding Yourself
chapters.description: Don't worry. Papa-G will fix it.

chapters.name: The Green Revolution
chapters.description: And remember crawlers: Kill, Kill, Kill! But only plants.

chapters.name: Getting Around...
chapters.description: Movement can be slow initially. But with some technology or magic, that is easily overcome!

chapters.name: ...Without Dying
chapters.description: In order to not die constantly, you'll need weapons and armor. There's also utility stuff, adventure backpacks, and static defenses for your base.

chapters.name: Building Better Bases
chapters.description: Tired of torches everywhere making your base look like a loser built it? Make your base look like a winner with these quests.

chapters.name: Forestry and Multifarms
chapters.description: Automated Farms, tree breeding, and more.....

chapters.name: Multiblock Goals
chapters.description: This set is a global tracker for multiblock structure goals. As you can build several parts of many multiblocks way earlier than the respective tier. Check back often.

chapters.name: Mass Processing
chapters.description: This tab showcases new high-speed multiblocks to replace your old machines as they become available. Check back regularly!

chapters.name: How to Generate Power
chapters.description: If there's a way to generate EU, it'll be on this tab, so check back after a new milestone to see if anything became available.

chapters.name: Storing and Transforming EU
chapters.description: You can find ways to store EU here and ways to transform between voltages.

chapters.name: Working with Oil
chapters.description: A questline about oil refining, oil byproducts, and oil based power generation.

chapters.name: Bio for the Masses
chapters.description: Questline about powergen that comes from plants and trees.

chapters.name: Powerful Nuclear Physics
chapters.description: A series of questlines dedicated to nuclear fission and fusion, both for power and useful items.

chapters.name: Space Race
chapters.description: A guide to help you start Galacticraft to reach the Moon and beyond

chapters.name: Basic Automation
chapters.description: Steve's Carts and ProjectRed automation, for your auto-farming and auto-crafting needs, lag included!

chapters.name: SFM and Computers
chapters.description: SFM and OC have your back for assline automation! And automating other stuff too complex for AE2, like infusion or blood altars. You can do a lot of cool stuff with OC, feel free to give it a try.

chapters.name: Handle Logistics with Pipes
chapters.description: No access to AE2 yet? Want to see items zooming around while crafting? Logistics Pipes is for You.

chapters.name: Applied Energistics
chapters.description: AE2 focuses on creating a compact, easily accessible, considerably extendible storage system called an ME Network. You can use it to autocraft items as well, and if you want to finish the pack, you will.

chapters.name: How to Be(e)
chapters.description: A non-tiered quest set that is meant as an in game, quest based tutorial and guide to bees. Since they are a really helpful tool to advance forward.

chapters.name: Be(e) Breeding
chapters.description: Breeding Bees for Better Bling (experimental, may cause honey leakage)

chapters.name: Hardcore End(er) Expansion
chapters.description: Treasure of lands far beyond the vast sea of the Void and very angry rune spiders await you!

chapters.name: Novice Thaumaturgy
chapters.description: Magic lies beyond. Great achievements, but also a lot of work. I shall be your guide. Follow my instructions, and you shall become a great wizard, like me.

chapters.name: Adept Thaumaturgy
chapters.description: Warp included.

chapters.name: Kaaami, Haaaami, ... HA!
chapters.description: Ultimate (magical) POWER!!!

chapters.name: Focus on Wand Foci & EMT
chapters.description: Do you know which wand focus is useful and which not? Also, some EMT stuff.

chapters.name: Flower Power
chapters.description: A treatise on magical herbology and Botania

chapters.name: Look to the Edges
chapters.description: Granny Weatherwax would approve.

chapters.name: Paying the Highest Price
chapters.description: When regular magic just won't cover it, pay demons to do it for you! The cost might scare some people... But no risk no fun!

chapters.name: Kill All the Things
chapters.description: This world is full of nasty things. Time to kill some and improve your reputation.

chapters.name: Unassigned source quests
chapters.description: These quests have no chapter placement in the source. This arrangement is generated, not an in-game chapter.

enderIO.quest: IO, IO, It's Off to EnderIO We Go
